svg.text: Correct choice → brief success feedback → next question automatically. No save is required.
Incorrect choice → reveal the answer → Save word or Skip → next question. Saving shows confirmation first.
Selecting Vocab returns to search. Selecting Common opens a question with exactly four answer choices.
Design-only sample: question bank, answer validation, saved words and progress will connect to the backend later.
Prototype timing: 800 ms success feedback. Loading blocks repeated answers. Batch completion offers more practice.
